It is at or below zero on frequent generic nouns, natural objects and narrative vocabulary (cat, river, bridge, table, song, poem, equation, time, way, value), on function words, and throughout code, JSON and markdown, while a separate orthographic component makes the byte-fragment tokens of non-Latin characters fire, which keeps whole Turkish passages (the tokens for i-dotless, s-cedilla, c-cedilla, o-umlaut) active where their ASCII-ised versions are silent.
